ruleDefinitions.name: Bad Opsec Defaults Sacrificial Processes With Improper Arguments
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects attackers using tooling with bad opsec defaults.
E.g. spawning a sacrificial process to inject a capability into the process without taking into account how the process is normally run.
One trivial example of this is using rundll32.exe without arguments as a sacrificial process (default in CS, now highlighted by c2lint), running WerFault without arguments (Kraken - credit am0nsec), and other examples.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\WerFault\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX("WerFault\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX("rundll32\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvcs\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX("regsvcs\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\regasm\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX("regasm\\\.exe$")) OR (process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX("regsvr32\\\.exe$"))) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Microsoft\\\\EdgeUpdate\\\\Install\\\\\\{.*") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX("rundll32\\\.exe$")) OR ((parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\BraveSoftware\\\\Brave\\-Browser\\\\Application\\\\.*") OR parent_process_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Google\\\\Chrome\\\\Application\\\\.*")) AND parent_process_path = RGX("\\\\Installer\\\\setup\\\.exe$") AND parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-uninstall\\ .*") AND process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$") AND process_command_line = RGX("rundll32\\\.exe$")))
